facts.text: The hotel is centrally located opposite Nuremberg central station and at the entrance of the historical old town.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel in Nuremberg is centrally located opposite Nuremberg central station and at the entrance of the historical old town.

facts.text: The hotel has easy access to the underground right outside the door.
facts.excerpt: with easy access to the underground right outside the door

facts.text: The building was originally a two-storey farmhouse with a hops storehouse.
facts.excerpt: Originally a two-storey farmhouse with a hops storehouse

facts.text: The hotel has a mirrored and chandeliered ballroom in Belle Epoque style that is a protected monument.
facts.excerpt: This elegantly mirrored and chandeliered room in Belle Epoque style is a protected monument

facts.text: The ballroom features motifs of Richard Wagner's operas.
facts.excerpt: Motives of the world famous Richard-Wagner-Operas create an atmosphere

facts.text: Famous guests who have stayed at the hotel include the Dalai Lama, Robbie Williams and The Beatles.
facts.excerpt: The Dalai Lama, Robbie Williams and The Beatles - the list of famous guests who once stayed at Le Méridien Grand Hotel Nuremberg is very long.

facts.text: The Albrecht-Duerer-Saal is decorated in Art Deco style and lit through a glass roof.
facts.excerpt: Lavishly decorated with the elegance of Art Deco style, the Albrecht-Duerer-Saal offers an outstanding surrounding combined with modern facilities and is tastefully lit through a glass roof.

facts.text: Rooms feature Art Nouveau-inspired marble bathrooms and contemporary artworks.
facts.excerpt: feature luxurious Art Nouveau-inspired marble bathrooms, contemporary artworks

facts.text: Rooms have the Le Méridien Bed, designed by LM 100 artist Nick Dine.
facts.excerpt: A special touch of luxury is the Le Méridien Bed, designed by LM 100 artist Nick Dine.

facts.text: Rooms provide views of the courtyard, the historic train station or the Old Quarter.
facts.excerpt: provide views of the courtyard, historic train station, or Old Quarter

facts.text: Guests find a complimentary admission ticket to the Neues Museum in their room.
facts.excerpt: If you want to experience contemporary art in matching surroundings, your next stop is Nuremberg's Neues Museum, located near the hotel. You will find a complimentary admission ticket in your room.

facts.text: The Neues Museum's contemporary art is a few minutes' walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Start your journey of discovery through the international contemporary art scene just a few minutes’ walk away

facts.text: Restaurant Brasserie has a show kitchen and serves regional specialties such as Nuremberg bratwurst.
facts.excerpt: The show kitchen at this restaurant in Nuremberg impresses guests with culinary discoveries like famous Nuremberg bratwurst sausages.

facts.text: The Atelier Bar serves specialty cocktails and drinks.
facts.excerpt: enjoy specialty cocktails and drinks offered at our hotel bar in Nuremberg

facts.text: The hotel hosts a Musical Dinner Show and a Murder Mystery Dinner.
facts.excerpt: A special highlight of our hotel is the Musical Dinner Show and the Murder Mystery Dinner

facts.text: The gym has cardio equipment and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Work out in the gym at our hotel near Nuremberg Exhibition Center with cardio equipment and sauna

facts.text: Trained pets are welcome to join guests on their stay.
facts.excerpt: we welcome trained pets to join you on your stay

facts.text: The hotel is near the Nuremberg River Cruise Port, convenient before or after a river cruise on the Main-Danube Canal.
facts.excerpt: With a convenient location near the Nuremberg River Cruise Port, Le Méridien Grand Hotel Nuremberg is the ideal place to stay before or after a river cruise on the Main-Danube Canal.

facts.text: Parking is off-site valet parking.
facts.excerpt: Off-site valet parking is available at Le Méridien Grand Hotel Nuremberg.

facts.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Le Méridien Grand Hotel Nuremberg do not have a fridge.

facts.text: The hotel joined Le Méridien Hotels in November 1996.
facts.excerpt: In November, after changing ownership several times, the Grand Hotel Nuremberg is incorporated into the world-renowned category of Le Méridien Hotels.
